name: smwpatches-fireball-hack
title: Fireball Hack
description:
Allows you to shoot fireballs up or diaganol. Right now theres only one bug, if you shoot up and theres a ledge above it the fireball will bounce up and down.
I'll fix that in a later version, and hopefully I make it so you can shoot up and diagonal and not just up or diagonal. Give Me Credit.
